entities.name: Richard Fröhlich
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Richard Georg Fröhlich is a German professional basketball player. He grew up in a small town called Oldendorf. The son of Georg and Vineta Fröhlich, he has 4 sisters; one of them, Linda Fröhlich, is considered the best women's player in Germany.
